summary: Read the roadmap and the as-built step records, then searched src/ for what already exists. The backlog is dominated by Step 12c (first live Azure environment) plus two operational gaps in the Centers.

sources.used: the one-time bootstrap already written down
which resources compile today but have never been applied

items.title: Stand up the first live Azure environment
items.body:
Step 12b left Bicep that compiles and Dockerfiles that build, with nothing deployed. This epic is the first environment that actually runs.

Out of scope: multi-region, autoscale, cost alerts.
acceptance_criteria: All four Centers are reachable in one Azure resource group
The Step 11 demo runs against the deployed environment

evidence.detail: templates compile in CI but infra.yml has never applied them

items.title: Bootstrap the subscription: resource group, federated identity, and CI secrets
items.body: One-time setup so deploy-center.yml can authenticate without a stored client secret.
acceptance_criteria: infra.yml runs what-if against the real subscription and exits 0
No client secret is stored in repository secrets

evidence.detail: the bootstrap steps are documented but not executed

items.title: Deploy the four Centers to Container Apps from CI
items.body: Wire deploy-center.yml to push each Center image and roll it out.
acceptance_criteria: deploy-center.yml deploys one Center on dispatch and reports the revision
GET /metrics on DashboardCenter answers from the deployed instance

evidence.detail: the workflow exists but has no live target

items.title: Add a DLQ replay button to the Dashboard UI
items.body: Operators should be able to replay a dead-lettered event without curl.
acceptance_criteria: The Vue UI lists DLQ entries and replays one on click

evidence.detail: DLQ is stored but the UI does not surface it

items.title: Introduce Squeaked v3 with a duck firmware version
items.body: Carry the emitting duck's firmware version so Centers can branch on it.
acceptance_criteria: Squeaked v3 upcasts from v2 in EventUpcasterPipeline

evidence.detail: v1 and v2 exist; no consumer has asked for v3

notes: A 'call BillingCenter from AlarmCenter to check the fee' idea appeared in the roadmap discussion; it violates rule 1 and is not an item.
